name: compact-page-action
goal: Page cards open through a compact icon with an accessible label, tooltip and unchanged navigation.

evidence: Page cards currently use a full-width text link. Keep a single compact icon, an accessible Open page label, a hover tooltip and the same destination at each viewport.
The unchanged local desktop regression fails: the full-width Open page arrow link has no concise accessible name or hover title. The same checkpoint screenshot was saved before asserting.
Reused WorkspaceLink and Icon for a 36px page action; added hover title support and readable contracts for the three edited components. Planned review links retain text.
All 18 renderer browser checks pass, including unchanged compact-action assertions in local and hosted modes at desktop, tablet and mobile sizes; Enter opens the same page.
